title: 第6章 拍的不错！-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    导演皱着眉，却没有喊“卡”。

    韩小汐反应过来准备站起身尖叫时，男人已经欺身上前。

    双手按在了她的肩上，贴着她的唇，低声制止：“别动。”

    韩小汐全程泡在浴桶里，呆若木鸡。

    她演砸了！

    直到外面安静下来。

    男人才松开她，一闪身，从窗户跃了出去。

    “卡！”于导这才喊停。

    现场一片安静。

    没有人动。

    连于清自己都蹙着眉头。

    韩小汐垮着肩坐在水里，水有些凉了。

    沈珩开门进来，打破了现场的宁静。

    “于导，能用吗？”他径直走向监视器。

    胶片时代，没法看回放。

    成片效果最快要到第二天下午才能看到。

    如果不行，还要补拍。

    于清没有回话，他摸着下巴，一副认真的小老头样。

    最终还是谨慎地说了一句：“再保一条。”

    沈珩没有任何反驳，“那，抓紧时间。”转身，顿了一下，又问，“按哪一版拍？”

    于清想了想，干脆拖着沈珩到了浴桶旁。

    韩小汐有些丧，抬头看着两人。

    沈珩冲她淡笑，“拍得不错。”

    韩小汐：您还真是大善人！

    没想到于清也跟着点头，“第一次拍戏，拍成这样，确实很不错。”他接着道，“再拍一条，按第一版拍，给我一个保底的，虽然我个人比较喜欢刚刚那个即兴的。”

    韩小汐没想到自己纯发呆，能得到导演的认可，连忙激动地点头。

    再次就位，有了刚刚的经验，韩小汐这次没忘记动作，按部就班顺畅地演了下来。

    不过于清是个完美主义者，要求补拍几个韩小汐扑水的特写动作，还跟摄影师强调一定要手部特写。

    一连串拍下来，水真的凉了。

    韩小汐从水里出来时，只有一个想法，三千块不是那么好拿的。

    偏偏她还找不到自己的衣服，连个给她递浴巾的都没有。

    自己全身湿哒哒的，站在忙着转场的片场无人问津。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The director frowned, but didn't shout "card".

When Han Xiaoxi reacted and was about to stand up and scream, the man had already stepped forward.

He put his hands on her shoulders, pressed against her lips, and whispered to stop: "Don't move."

Han Xiaoxi stayed in the bathtub the whole time, dumbfounded.

She failed in her performance!

Until it gets quiet outside.

The man let go of her, dodged, and jumped out of the window.

"Stuck!" Director Yu shouted to stop.

The scene was quiet.

No one moved.

Even Yu Qing himself frowned.

Han Xiaoxi sat in the water with slumped shoulders. The water was a little cold.

Shen Heng opened the door and came in, breaking the tranquility of the scene.

"Director Yu, can it be used?" He walked straight to the monitor.

In the film era, there was no way to watch playback.

The finished film effect will not be visible until the afternoon of the next day at the earliest.

If it doesn’t work, you have to take another shot.

Yu Qing didn’t reply. He touched his chin, looking like a serious old man.

In the end, he said cautiously: "One more thing."

Shen Heng didn’t have any rebuttal, “Then, hurry up.” He turned around, paused, and then asked, “Which version should I shoot?”

Yu Qing thought for a while and simply dragged Shen Heng to the tub.

Han Xiaoxi felt a little sad and looked up at the two of them.

Shen Heng smiled lightly at her, "That's a good shot."

Han Xiaoxi: You are really a kind person!

Unexpectedly, Yu Qing also nodded, "It's my first time to shoot a movie, and it's really good to shoot it like this." He continued, "Take another one, shoot it according to the first version, give me a guarantee, although I personally prefer the improvised one just now."

Han Xiaoxi didn’t expect that she could be recognized by the director because she was just in a daze, so she nodded excitedly.

Once again in position, with the experience just now, Han Xiaoxi did not forget the movements this time and performed smoothly step by step.

However, Tai Qing was a perfectionist and asked for a few more close-ups of Han Xiaoxi's splashing into the water. He also emphasized to the photographer that the hand shots must be close-ups.

After taking a series of photos, the water was really cold.

When Han Xiaoxi came out of the water, she had only one thought: three thousand yuan is not that easy to get.

But she couldn’t find her own clothes, and no one even handed her a bath towel.

I was wet all over, and no one cared about me as I stood on the busy set.
